steps.say: Visualize History shows what a Set said on every past day. | Open a scan, and press the clock.
The price is drawn with coloured bands behind it. | Green is Yes. Amber is Unknown. | No is left clear.
Underneath, every other asset in the scan gets a small chart of its own, with the same bands. | So you can compare them at a glance.
Tap a small chart, and that asset moves to the top.
Choose how far back to look: one year, three, ten, or everything. | Older years load in the background, marked with an hourglass.
Open on the main price chart takes the asset and its bands to your dashboard chart.
The bands show when the conditions were met. | They don't say what happened next. | That is the job of the next video.
